problemStatement.formal: Does there exist a function f such that every finite graph G with chromatic number at least f(k), for k >= 3, contains an odd cycle whose vertex span has chromatic number at least k?
problemStatement.plain: Erdos #640 asks whether sufficiently high chromatic number forces an odd cycle whose induced vertex span is itself highly chromatic.
whyMatters: This is an Erdos-Hajnal question linking global chromatic number to the chromatic complexity around odd cycles.
The Lean file records the conjecture, Steiner path variant, and supporting colorability lemmas.
Two named axioms remain, so the metadata must not present the general conjecture as proved.

open: The general Erdos-Hajnal conjecture is not proved in Lean.
